description: TmDocumentCoreEngineHost Blazor component in the Document Editor category.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: The document to render/edit with the core engine.

parameters.name: ChangeDebounceMs
parameters.description: Raised once the engine has mounted (the handle exists) — wire collaboration here (R.5.22).

parameters.name: OnContextMenu
parameters.description: Raised (JS→.NET, debounced) when the engine's model changes — drives autosave (R.5.3).

parameters.name: OnModelChanged
parameters.description: Raised (JS→.NET) when an image object is selected/deselected in the engine.

parameters.name: OnObjectSelected
parameters.description: Page geometry passed to the engine layout.

parameters.name: OnOperation
parameters.description: Raised (JS→.NET) on right-click — carries the engine context + viewport position (R.5.23).

parameters.name: OnReady
parameters.description: Raised (JS→.NET) when a local edit produces a text operation — broadcast for collaboration (R.5.22).

parameters.name: PageSettings
parameters.description: Accessible label for the editor surface.
